# Jiffy Lube Chicagoland

> Official site for 104 Jiffy Lube service centers in the Chicago area (Illinois, northwest Indiana and southeast Wisconsin). Oil changes in about 15 minutes, no appointment needed. Each location page lists the street address, phone number, today's hours, Google rating and a printable or mobile-wallet coupon code.

Current offers (valid through January 31, 2027):
- $11 OFF any oil change at most locations, code D1S6F3
- $22 OFF any oil change, plus a free tire pressure check and fill at Jiffy Lube 1600 N Larkin Ave, Joliet, code GG1AD22
- $22 OFF any oil change, plus a free tire pressure check and fill at Jiffy Lube 1941 Dempster St, Evanston, code GG1AD22
- $22 OFF any oil change, plus a free tire pressure check and fill at Jiffy Lube 1644 W Jefferson St, Joliet, code GG1AD22
- Free tire pressure check and fill, and free battery test, no purchase necessary, at the 3 locations listed under Free services.
